items.claim: Joseph is drawn out of the pit and sold to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver.
items.ruling: The Qur’an says only that they sold him for a reduced price, a few dirhams (12:20). It gives no figure. We neither believe nor disbelieve twenty pieces.
items.basis: Qur’an 12:19-20; the Bible text (Genesis 37:18-36, NRSVUE) read on BibleGateway

items.claim: Reuben says they should not take his life and proposes the pit, meaning to rescue him; Judah proposes selling him instead of killing him.
items.ruling: The Qur’an has “a speaker among them” say not to kill Yusuf but to throw him into the well (12:10) and names no brother. We neither believe nor disbelieve which brother said what.
items.basis: Qur’an 12:8-10; the Bible text (Genesis 37:18-36, NRSVUE) read on BibleGateway
